}
console.log(greet('World'));

Python

def calculate_squares(numbers: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    return [n ** 2 for n in numbers]

print(calculate_squares([1, 2, 3, 4]))

C++

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::vector<int> nums = {10, 20, 30};
    for (int n : nums) {
        std::cout << n << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
